sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:26

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:26:1
items.html: A very great illumination, and then, through the mingling of the two lights together, etc.: That is, the illumination of the five Gevurot that ZA receives from Ima, which is the secret of the partnership of the quality of mercy within judgment, as is known — for all the Mochin of ZA, up to the very completion of his greatness, depend on these five Gevurot that he receives from Ima. And therefore he calls them a very great illumination.
